mapper.select:
SELECT j.jeongmo_id, j.jeongmo_date, j.start_time, j.end_time, j.place, j.reg_dtm, j.chg_dtm, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jeongmo_required_members r WHERE r.jeongmo_id = j.jeongmo_id) AS required_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_records a WHERE a.jeongmo_id = j.jeongmo_id) AS actual_count FROM jeongmos j
AND j.jeongmo_date = #{jeongmoDate}
AND UPPER(j.place) LIKE CONCAT('%', UPPER(#{place}), '%')
ORDER BY j.jeongmo_date DESC, j.start_time DESC, j.place ASC, j.jeongmo_id DESC

SELECT jeongmo_id, jeongmo_date, start_time, end_time, place, reg_dtm, chg_dtm, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jeongmo_required_members r WHERE r.jeongmo_id = jeongmos.jeongmo_id) AS required_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attendance_records a WHERE a.jeongmo_id = jeongmos.jeongmo_id) AS actual_count FROM jeongmos WHERE jeongmo_id = #{jeongmoId}
SELECT jeongmo_id FROM jeongmos ORDER BY jeongmo_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO jeongmos ( jeongmo_id, jeongmo_date, start_time, end_time, place, reg_dtm, chg_dtm ) VALUES ( #{jeongmoId}, #{jeongmoDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{place}, #{regDtm}, #{chgDtm} )
